name: Border color
desc: Color of the tile borders

name: Marker line color
desc: Color of the marker line (the one that appears every 5 tiles)

name: Marker number color
desc: Color of the marker numbers

name: Fulfilled number color
desc: Color of the number that indicates when a hint number has been filled

name: Head tile background color
desc: Color of the background of the head of the rows and columns

name: Head tile number color
desc: Color of the numbers within the head of the rows and columns

name: Tile color
desc: Inner color of the tiles

name: Tile hover color
desc: The color of the tiles upon hovering with a selector

name: Tile hover highlight color
desc: The color of the tiles in the same row and column as the tile that is being hovered

name: Drag fill color
desc: The color of the tiles when dragged in FILL mode

name: Drag cross color
desc: The color of the tiles when dragged in CROSS mode

name: Tile filled color
desc: The filled color of the tiles

name: Selector highlight color
desc: The color of the tiles in the same row and column as the selector

name: Selector outline color
desc: The outline color of the selector

name: Float background color
desc: The background color of the floating number counter

name: Standard button color
desc: The color of a button when not activated

name: Active button color
desc: The color of a button when active

name: Hover button color
desc: The color of a button when hovered with mouse

name: Button shadow color
desc: The color of the shadow of the button

name: User interface color
desc: The background color of the user interface
